decision: Prespecified a tolerance of 2 absolute percentage points before panel-size results were generated.
selection_rule: Select the smallest evaluated panel with mean training cross-validation balanced accuracy at least the corresponding full-gene reference mean minus 0.02.
constraints: Gene selection and preprocessing must occur within each fitting fold.
Use identical validation folds for panels and full-gene references.
Account for hyperparameter selection within the evaluation procedure.
The final test set must not select the model, panel size, or tolerance.
Report fold variation and per-class recall alongside the mean.
This is a practical selection criterion, not proof of clinical equivalence or statistical noninferiority.
selection_method: ANOVA F-score ranking fitted within every inner and outer fitting set
pam50_comparison: Prespecified a separate fixed published PAM50 gene-list benchmark; not the original classifier
